summary: Verified admin-only OpenAI API Configuration end-to-end (backend + UI). Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_openai_settings.py (3 tests) all PASS: 401 for unauthenticated GET/POST/DELETE, save→test→remove flow never leaks plaintext, non-'sk-' save returns 400. Frontend Playwright on https://uno-word-build.preview.emergentagent.com: admin login works, Settings tab renders the OpenAI panel with all required data-testids (openai-form, openai-status, openai-status-label, openai-key-input, openai-key-toggle, openai-save, openai-test, openai-remove, openai-msg, openai-err). Masking: input type=password by default, toggles to text and back. Validation: 'not-a-real-key-123456' → 400 and user-visible err 'That does not look like an OpenAI API key (expected to start with sk-).'. Save with dummy 'sk-proj-UNOWORD-UI-TEST-0...' → success msg 'API key saved.', status label 'Saved — not tested yet' (amber), source 'server-stored key ····0000'. Full key NOT present in DOM, in localStorage, or in any /api/admin/openai-* response payload. Status label never read 'Connected' from just saving. Test Connection on the dummy key → status 'Connection failed', openai-err 'The API key was rejected by OpenAI.' (friendly, no stack trace, no key). Remove with confirm() → DELETE 200; GET /api/admin/openai-settings now returns source='environment', key_hint=null, key_set_at=null — cleanup CONFIRMED (dummy key is gone, live app falls back to env OPENAI_API_KEY). Response shape returned only {configured, source, key_hint, key_set_at, last_test_at, last_test_ok, chat_model, embed_model} — no raw key field. Login-page admin-lang-toggle switches EN→ES correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: openai_config._fernet() falls back to a hardcoded 'uno-word-settings-dev' material if neither SETTINGS_ENC_KEY nor ADMIN_JWT_SECRET nor SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is set. In production you should assert one of those is present and fail fast rather than silently using a known constant to derive the Fernet key.

After Remove, when env OPENAI_API_KEY is set, status.configured=true and the UI shows 'Saved — not tested yet · environment key'. That is technically correct but the label 'Saved' can read as if an admin-saved key still exists — consider a distinct label like 'Using environment key' for source=environment. Not a defect.

OpenAIPanel caches testState in React state; after Remove it resets to 'idle' so a stale last_test_ok from env source (none in this run) could flip the label to 'Connected'. Current flow is correct because remove_openai_key() also clears last_test_* in DB.
Backend /openai-test returns HTTP 200 even on auth failure (ok=false). This is intentional (semantic result in body) and is handled correctly by the UI.

context_for_next_testing_agent: OpenAI admin panel is fully covered. Live env has OPENAI_API_KEY set but it is INVALID (rejected by OpenAI) — a 'Connection failed / The API key was rejected by OpenAI.' result on Test Connection is EXPECTED, not a defect. Always run cleanup (DELETE /api/admin/openai-key) if you save a dummy key.
